identification: Three vintage Australian valve mantel radios, not tested. Two matching 1959-63 style wedge-front plastic cabinets (tan and brown) with grille, state dial (WA/QLD/TAS/NSW/VIC/SA) and an emblem that appears to be Healing's H badge (not certain), plus a cream/black 1960s mantel radio with a round dial (script name unreadable). Brown one has a cracked top corner, tan one has loose wires.
